properties.name: A reply can concede an objection against one reading of an argument and move to another reading, and reads as that
properties.source: @ajs, 2026-10-18: "Capture the shortcomings (gaps) from the trial" (cogito trial)
properties.statement:
A reply can say: "granted, against reading A; the argument is meant as reading B". The objection then reads as standing against A only, B is linked as the answer, and the read-back says so, rather than showing two unrelated alternative routes.
Observed in the cogito trial (2026-10-18): Descartes answers the syllogism objections (an unproven major premise; begging the question) by moving to the intuition reading. That could only be written into warrants and as alternative steps, with no edge between the objection and the move.
